coverage: title + tagline + job relevance + 8 outcomes + 8 theory code/output blocks + 9 callouts + 2 figures

top_level.justification: Matches roadmap ownership; no change needed.

top_level.current_content: extrae campos de documentos sintéticos, conserva bounding boxes/evidencia, abstiene bajo confidence y mide cada campo crítico
top_level.improved_content: Procesa un documento sintético hasta campos trazables: conserva página/bbox y provenance, normaliza la confianza del motor, abstiene por cada campo crítico y evalúa calidad/cobertura sobre el mismo golden.
top_level.justification: Current theory does not earn several nouns in the gate: real document extraction, evidence retention, all-critical-field confidence or connected selective evaluation.

top_level.current_content: En un backoffice de Lima (facturas, boletas y PDFs de proveedores), el cuello de botella no es «leer letras»: es convertir un PDF en campos con evidencia que un humano pueda auditar en minutos. Aquí aprendes a modelar el camino: preproceso → OCR con confidence y bounding box → schema → validación cross-field → cola de revisión humana y métricas por campo. El valor profesional es encolar bien, no cerrar casos por score ni inventar dígitos de RUC.
top_level.improved_content: En un backoffice, el reto es convertir cada documento en campos que un humano pueda verificar contra el **mismo archivo y página**. El flujo debe empezar por un artefacto de origen verificado, registrar las transformaciones y el motor OCR, conservar raw/value/confidence/bbox con su espacio de coordenadas, validar con un schema versionado y crear una cola de revisión auditable. El objetivo es decidir cuándo abstenerse; OCR nunca decide fraude ni inventa un RUC.
top_level.justification: Makes the auditability promise concrete and does not inherit S23's unearned source state.

learning_outcomes.current_content: Preprocesar metadatos de imagen sintética (DPI, deskew, crop, contraste) y dejar flags auditables
learning_outcomes.improved_content: Distinguir señales/planes de preprocesamiento de transformaciones realmente aplicadas y verificadas, preservando `source_ppi`, configuración, transformaciones y hashes antes/después.
learning_outcomes.justification: Current code writes applied-looking flags and dpi=200 without changing pixels.

learning_outcomes.current_content: Corregir ruido y orientación antes de invocar el motor OCR
learning_outcomes.improved_content: Aplicar un gate de orientación con rama manual ante baja/ambigua confianza y demostrar, o describir honestamente como plan, la corrección de ruido antes de OCR.
learning_outcomes.justification: Orientation manual threshold and real denoise are not implemented.

learning_outcomes.current_content: Consumir un contrato OCR (idiomas, confidence por campo y orden de lectura sintético por bbox)
learning_outcomes.improved_content: Consumir un contrato OCR que normaliza la escala de confidence, conserva raw confidence/engine/lang/page/coordinate space y limita el orden `(y,x)` a layouts simples.
learning_outcomes.justification: Tesseract scale, page/bbox provenance and multi-column limits are missing.

learning_outcomes.current_content: Extraer texto, tablas y pares clave–valor con evidencia del valor
learning_outcomes.improved_content: Extraer candidatos de texto/tablas/KV sin sobrescribir duplicados y conservar raw value, confidence, bbox, página y fuente hasta resolver ambigüedades.
learning_outcomes.justification: Current kv parser outputs only strings and overwrites duplicate keys.

learning_outcomes.current_content: Normalizar a schema (RUC 11 dígitos, montos PE, fechas ISO) sin inventar valores
learning_outcomes.improved_content: Normalizar con un schema ejecutable: RUC acepta solo separadores allowlisted, montos PE se validan por gramática y convierten a Decimal/centavos, fechas siguen política explícita; cualquier formato no admitido se abstiene.
learning_outcomes.justification: Current total parser misparses an explicitly forbidden format and RUC parser strips unexpected Unicode characters.

learning_outcomes.current_content: Validar cross-field, acumular reasons[] y encolar revisión sin label de fraude
learning_outcomes.improved_content: Validar required/confidence/reglas entre campos sin excepciones por missing y crear un registro de revisión con evidence+reasons; discrepancia sigue sin ser etiqueta de fraude.
learning_outcomes.justification: Current validator can KeyError and returns only a tuple rather than a queue item.

learning_outcomes.current_content: Evaluar exactitud por campo y coverage_auto sobre un golden set sintético
learning_outcomes.improved_content: Evaluar por campo con denominadores de ground truth explícitos y calcular, en el mismo golden/threshold, error de autoaceptados, coverage selectiva, end-to-end auto rate y tasas reject/fail/rescan con `n` visible.
learning_outcomes.justification: None==None inflates accuracy and current coverage is disconnected from the golden and excludes failure states.

learning_outcomes.current_content: Aplicar gates de admisión (mime/tamaño como capa 1) y fallback human_rescan
learning_outcomes.improved_content: Aplicar un screening de capa 1 que valida metadata/MIME/tamaño sin crashes, reconocer sus límites frente a archivos hostiles y enrutar fallos determinísticos de OCR a `human_rescan` con evidencia.
learning_outcomes.justification: Current gate can KeyError and no human_rescan path is implemented.

theory_code_output.title: preprocess.py
theory_code_output.current_behavior: 96 dpi source -> reports 200, deskew_applied=True, crop_box 2%, contrast 1.2; output `200 True 20 1.2`.
theory_code_output.improved_content: Emit `source_ppi=96`, `target_ppi=200` only as plan, `deskew_required=True`; a real transform adapter must produce processed_sha256 before any `*_applied=True`. Fixed crop requires a preservation check.
theory_code_output.justification: Published output is reproducible but semantically false as evidence of image transformation.

theory_code_output.title: noise_orient.py
theory_code_output.current_behavior: max orientation returns 180/0.7; denoise maps [0,1,0,1,0] to all zeros.
theory_code_output.improved_content: Return `{status,orientation,score,margin}` and `manual_orient` for low score/tie; rename fake denoise to `denoise_required_flags` or add an actual raster example.
theory_code_output.justification: The code never implements the documented <0.5 gate.

theory_code_output.title: ocr_conf.py
theory_code_output.current_behavior: Copies pre-supplied token text/conf/bbox, defaults lang='spa', sorts globally by (y0,x0), filters conf<0.85; output FACTURA→RUC→value and one low token.
theory_code_output.improved_content: Adapter starts from page pixels/real fixture, normalizes raw engine confidence, records engine/lang/page/coordinate space; simple y/x sort is explicitly single-column-only.
theory_code_output.justification: The block parses invented observations rather than demonstrating OCR and omits the Tesseract 0-100 normalization boundary.

theory_code_output.title: kv_tables.py
theory_code_output.current_behavior: Parses lines into a plain dict and prints 2 table data rows; no conf/bbox field object.
theory_code_output.improved_content: Return candidate objects with raw/value/conf/bbox/page/source; duplicate keys remain candidates/review; monetary cells normalize to Decimal before any sum.
theory_code_output.justification: The code discards the evidence the adjacent callout calls mandatory.

theory_code_output.title: schema_norm.py
theory_code_output.current_behavior: SCHEMA is decorative; norm_ruc rejects only ASCII letters and strips other non-digits; norm_total guesses comma+dot as PE and returns float; output RUC/date/150.0.
theory_code_output.improved_content: Drive required/type/normalizer from schema; RUC allowlists separators and rejects other Unicode; money grammar rejects unsupported forms and returns Decimal; preserve raw+normalized.
theory_code_output.justification: Runtime counterexamples directly contradict the prose's fail-closed rules.

theory_code_output.title: crossfield.py
theory_code_output.current_behavior: Uses float sum/0.01, checks RUC confidence only, returns tuple status/reasons; missing total KeyErrors.
theory_code_output.improved_content: Presence/type validation first, Decimal reconciliation, schema-driven confidence checks for all critical fields, then emit review record with source/evidence/reasons.
theory_code_output.justification: Current code is not fail-closed on missing required values and has no queue artifact.

theory_code_output.title: golden_eval.py
theory_code_output.current_behavior: Exact equality on two rows; fixed unrelated auto=7/review=3 yields coverage 0.7.
theory_code_output.improved_content: Define eligible truth rows/missing policy; run one threshold over one golden and compute field error/accuracy for autoaccepted, selective coverage and end-to-end rates including rejects/failures; guard n=0.
theory_code_output.justification: Current numbers cannot evaluate the threshold/coverage trade-off.

theory_code_output.title: hostile_gate.py
theory_code_output.current_behavior: Checks caller MIME, n_bytes and encrypted flag; accepts declared PDF bytes without signature and crashes on missing mime/n_bytes; no OCR-fail fallback.
theory_code_output.improved_content: Validate metadata schema first; label this layer1; add at least magic-signature mismatch fixture/resource budgets concept; add post-OCR error router to human_rescan.
theory_code_output.justification: The code is a useful first screen but not the complete T4 contract.

callouts.title: Alcance de esta sección
callouts.current_content: Dominas el contrato de intake ... FakeOcrAdapter ... TesseractAdapter llama un motor real si está instalado.
callouts.improved_content: Los fakes prueban parsing/abstención; el gate requiere una página sintética procesada por un adapter que declare engine/version y normalice confidence. Si no hay Tesseract en runtime, marca esa evidencia `not_executed`, no la simules.
callouts.justification: Clarifies unit-test evidence versus OCR gate evidence.

callouts.title: Criterio de preproceso antes del motor
callouts.current_content: dpi ≥200 (ideal300), deskew_applied if skew, crop safe, contrast cap; flags register decision.
callouts.improved_content: source_ppi is immutable; 200 is warning floor and 300 preferred target; *_required/planned differs from *_applied; crop must be verified against content and applied page hash.
callouts.justification: Current checklist can falsely certify a metadata-only transformation.

callouts.title: Orden obligatorio: orientar → luego OCR
callouts.current_content: score 180/0.7 rotate before OCR; score<0.5 manual_orient.
callouts.improved_content: Keep the rule and add tie/near-tie manual branch; code must emit status and negative fixture.

callouts.title: Abstención por campo crítico (no por promedio)
callouts.current_content: RUC conf<0.85 review_queue; min/field-wise, no averaging.
callouts.improved_content: Normalize engine confidence to 0-1, preserve raw scale, apply threshold per schema-critical field, calibrate on golden; do not average fields.
callouts.justification: Retains the correct anti-average rule while fixing scale/completeness.

callouts.title: Evidencia = valor + bbox del valor
callouts.current_content: field dict should keep name,value,conf,bbox; label bbox not enough.
callouts.improved_content: Keep raw/value/conf plus page, coordinate_space, processed/source hash; code must actually emit the object and preserve duplicate candidates.
callouts.justification: BBox alone is not reproducible after transforms.

callouts.title: None ≠ 0 (y coma ≠ miles)
callouts.current_content: RUC letters/length -> None; PE 150,00 ->150.0; do not zero-fill.
callouts.improved_content: None remains missing; money validates grammar then Decimal; RUC rejects any non-allowlisted Unicode character, not only ASCII letters.
callouts.justification: Current normalization violates the callout for explicit counterexamples.

callouts.title: Política: needs_review ≠ fraude
callouts.current_content: mismatch/missing/low confidence only produce reasons and needs_review; no auto_fraud.
callouts.improved_content: Retain ethical rule; ensure every required/critical field can generate reasons without crashing and persist a review item with evidence.
callouts.justification: Policy is good; implementation is incomplete.

callouts.title: Reporta el par: accuracy de campo + cobertura
callouts.current_content: acc_ruc, acc_total, coverage_auto; if coverage rises and acc_ruc falls threshold bad.
callouts.improved_content: Compute field quality and coverage from the same threshold/golden; state eligible n and end-to-end reject/fail/rescan denominators.
callouts.justification: Current hardcoded 7/3 coverage cannot be related to the two-row accuracy.

callouts.title: Gate antes del motor + minimización
callouts.current_content: mime allowlist, size cap, OCR; ocr_fail->human_rescan; 'Borra imágenes crudas cuando el expediente solo necesita campos + bbox'.
callouts.improved_content: Layer1 metadata/MIME/size is only screening; ocr_fail creates a real human_rescan record; never delete the only rendition/transform mapping needed to interpret bbox—retain it under controlled access until review/retention expiry.
callouts.justification: Current deletion sentence contradicts the preceding privacy paragraph and fallback is prose-only.

figures.caption: Reescalar de 96 a 200 no añade detalle: interpola píxeles que nunca se registraron.
figures.alt: Cuatro etapas —captura, deskew, OCR, campos— con la frontera tras la captura.
figures.justification: The figure communicates the correct non-recoverability principle; the contradiction is in code, not this visual.

figures.caption: Sin la región guardada, un revisor no puede comprobar de dónde salió el número que va a aprobar.
figures.alt: Grafo de imagen a región a texto con confianza, que se bifurca a campo aceptado o a revisión.
figures.improved_content: Caption/alt should show `source page/hash → processed rendition/transform → bbox/value/confidence → auto or review`, making page/coordinate lineage visible rather than treating an unanchored region as sufficient.
figures.justification: The visual is the right place to dual-code the missing coordinate/provenance relationship.
